defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced, 52 EACH received (8 kits refused at the dock as damaged)
rationale: Unit price matches the PO exactly and no UOM conversion is needed. GR-7724 records 52 of 60 EACH received (8 refused damaged), so under clause 4 the invoice is short-paid on the received quantity: 52 x $320.00 = $16,640.00 net, with tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate = $1,248.00 (clause 5), giving $17,888.00. The supplier's $1,440.00 tax is correct for its own 7.5% rate and differs only as a consequence of the quantity correction, so this is the single defect and clause 11 escalation is not triggered. Clause 10 puts approval with AP_MANAGER.
